data.summary:
Highly results-oriented and certified Technical Project Manager with 15+ years of experience leading complex software development projects from inception to delivery specializing in architecting and delivering robust, scalable enterprise solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices. Proven expertise in Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban), stakeholder management, and cross-functional team leadership. Skilled in managing projects involving Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Kafka, and AWS, ensuring on-time and on-budget delivery of high-quality technical solutions. Seeking to leverage strong technical acumen and project management expertise to drive successful product development.
Core Competencies / Technical Skills
Programming Languages: Java (Expert)
Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, Junit, Mockito, Spring AI
Microservices: Design & Architecture, REST, gRPC, Service Discovery, Resilience & Fault tolerance, Scalable, API Gateway
Cloud Platforms: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EKS), Docker, Kubernetes, Pivotal Cloud Foundry
Messaging/Streaming: Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS
Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Oracle
CI/CD & DevOps: Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Maven, Gradle, Git
Tools: JIRA, Confluence, Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman
Logging & monitoring: Splunk, ELK Stack, Grafana, Prometheus, Micrometer, Aternity,  AppDynamics
Methodologies: Agile (Scrum, Kanban), TDD, BDD
Leadership/Soft Skills: Team Leadership, Mentoring, Technical Architecture, System Design, Problem Solving, Communication
Project Management Methodologies: Agile (Scrum Master, SAFe,Kanban), Waterfall, Hybrid, Lean
Project Management Tools: JIRA, Confluence, Asana, Microsoft Project, Trello, Azure DevOps
Key PM Skills: Project Planning, Scope Management, Budget Management, Risk Management, Stakeholder Management, Change Management, Vendor Management, Resource Allocation, Quality Assurance
Technical Domain Expertise: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, RESTful APIs, Kafka, AWS (Cloud Architecture, CI/CD, DevOps), Docker, Kubernetes
Domains: BFSI(Banking & Finance),Retail , E-Commerce, Supply Chain.
Leadership & Communication: Team Leadership, Cross-functional Team Coordination, Conflict Resolution, Mentoring, Presentation Skills, Client Relations, Requirements Gathering
SDLC: Full SDLC Management, Requirements Elicitation, Testing & QA Oversight, Deployment Planning
Key Responsibilities & Achievements:
Managed a cross-functional team of 40+ developers, QAs, and DevOps engineers in the delivery of a new Microservices-based platform on AWS, reducing time-to-market by 25%.
Implemented Agile (Scrum) practices across 3 development teams, improving team velocity by 30% and increasing stakeholder satisfaction by streamlining communication.
Proactively identified and mitigated project risks, resulting in a 15% reduction in critical blockers and ensuring seamless project progression.
Bridged communication gaps between technical architects (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka) and business stakeholders, translating complex technical requirements into actionable project plans.
Architected and implemented highly scalable, successful integration of Kafka messaging queues into a real-time data processing system, handling 10,000+ messages per second.
Mentored junior and mid-level, Senior Lead & Developers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and contributing to a 25% reduction in critical bugs
Collaborated with product owners and stakeholders to define technical roadmap and architectural vision for enterprise applications.
Guided the transition of on-premise applications to AWS cloud infrastructure, collaborating with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipeline implementation.
Academic Qualification:
B.Sc (Information Technology) from Mumbai University (ST Gonsalo Garcia College,  Vasai Road (W), India) in May-2008.
H.S.C from Maharasthra Board (New English Junior College, Vasai Road (W), India) in March-2004.
S.S.C from Maharasthra Board (Holy Paradise High School, Vasai Road (W), India) in March -2002.
languages: KNOWN		: English, Hindi, Marathi, and Telugu.
EXTRA CURRICULAR ACTIVITES	: Active participation in various cultural and sporting
activities at school and college level.
